BiblicalUsage: Besor means "cheerful." It was a stream, torrent-bed, or wadi in extreme south of Judah in Philistia; empties into the Mediterranean Sea. It turns up in 1 Samuel 30:9, 1 Samuel 30:10 and 1 Samuel 30:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Besor is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
